{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
df_duplicated = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
num_duplicated_patients = df_duplicated.sum()

# Report the number of rows with duplicate patient_id
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {num_duplicated_patients}')"}
